title: A worker's gate that the class rule makes blocking can get its do entries after it is added
goal: Retrospective of SP-avwlotax: ST-jv27pfin's worker added g2 as provisional; gate add printed 'made blocking' (class agents-rule) and backlog.py check then warned that g2 has no do for either option, which the worker could not repair: gate add takes --do only at creation and gate remove is operator-only. A gate's do entries can be added to an existing gate by its item's worker (or gate add's made-blocking message tells it to pass --do up front), so check has no such warning after a worker's gate.
